purpose: Test a genuine auxiliary-variable active-coverage and decoy-exposure QUBO after Stage19g found stable higher-order residuals but no stable greedy gap.

diagnostic.coverage_rank_definition: median rank fraction across primary, sensitivity, seed0, seed1, and seed2 train scenarios; lower score ranks first
diagnostic.active_weight_definition: exponential early-rank weight exp(-BEDROC_alpha * median_rank_fraction), normalized to sum one over active ligands
diagnostic.decoy_weight_definition: same exponential early-rank weighting, normalized to sum one over decoys

variables.y_a: active ligand covered by at least one selected receptor
variables.z_d: decoy exposed by at least one selected receptor
variables.s_a: binary slack variables for y_a plus slack equals active coverage count

algorithm.decoy_constraint: z_d >= x_i for every receptor i that exposes decoy d; positive z_d objective coefficient sets z_d to zero when unexposed
algorithm.reduced_objective: active weighted coverage - decoy_weight * weighted decoy exposure + singleton_weight * mean singleton utility - redundancy_weight * mean positive score correlation
algorithm.selection_solver: exact enumeration of all 560 receptor triples with auxiliary assignment reconstruction; full variable QUBO coefficients and energy-equivalence certificate exported

development_support_gate.decision: A positive result would only justify pre-registered review of an independent-target experiment; it never authorizes BACE1 directly. A failed result stops this coverage objective before new docking.

interpretation_boundary: Stage 19h is post-hoc train-only development over MK14 and PPARG. It does not create independent validation, does not modify prior failed gates, does not read BACE1, fresh-validation, or locked-test rows, and does not demonstrate quantum execution or quantum advantage. Its purpose is to decide whether a constraint-faithful auxiliary QUBO is worth a separately preregistered external test.
